summary: Susy's picks are in the Q Shop: pomades, beard care, sulfate-free scalp care, fragrance and a body trimmer, chosen for men's hair and Siesta Key humidity. The hair salon finish, at home.

Pomade, clay or cream? The right product makes a hair salon cut look right at home. For shine, American Crew Pomade. For matte hold, Brickell Styling Clay. For a signature scent, 18.21 Man Made Sweet Tobacco Pomade. All three are in Susy's picks for Longboat Key weather.

A barber shop fade deserves a top that matches. 18.21 Man Made Pomade in Sweet Tobacco gives a clean, controlled finish and a scent people notice. Find it with Susy's other styling picks in the Q Shop, ready for Lido Key days.
Long day, humid commute? American Crew Pomade gives medium hold and a classic high shine that keeps an executive cut looking sharp. It's one of Susy's picks for Sarasota men, in the Q Shop.

Florida sun and pool chlorine are hard on hair color, and sulfate-free shampoo is gentler on it. The Cardon Strengthening Shampoo & Conditioner set is sulfate-free, with salicylic acid, biotin and yeast extract. Find it in Susy's picks for Downtown Sarasota hair salon clients.

Men's skin care doesn't need ten steps: cleanse, moisturize, protect. Lakewood Ranch clients make the drive downtown for the Gentleman's Facial, 45 minutes of cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate at our men's facial spa. Ask Susy what to use at home. Book your facial with Susy.

Beard frizz in Siesta Key? Wash it two or three times a week, not daily, then work a few drops of oil into the damp beard. DOC HOLLIDAY Beard Oil in Smoked Huckleberry is lightweight and non-greasy, with jojoba, aloe and biotin. Barber shop beard care, at home. Shop Susy's picks.

Holiday family visit coming up? Q Salon gift cards from $50 work for any hair salon service. Perfect for dads, sons and grandfathers in Longboat Key. Want something to unwrap too? Susy's picks include beard kits, pomades and fragrance.

A skin fade looks best with matte texture on top. Brickell Styling Clay Pomade gives a matte finish and strong hold, made with argan oil and green tea. A little goes a long way. Shop Susy's styling picks for Lido Key.

Stocking stuffers from a barber shop pro: DOC HOLLIDAY Beard Oil, a tin of 18.21 Man Made Pomade, or the full Viking Revolution beard kit with wash, conditioner, oil, balm and comb. Shop Susy's picks for Sarasota gift-givers.

Party-proof styling for a long night in Downtown Sarasota: work American Crew Pomade through damp hair for medium hold and shine, then finish with Cupids Hypnosis Eau de Parfum, citrus over warm vanilla. Both are in Susy's picks.

Protect your hair salon color through the holidays. Sulfate-free shampoo is gentler on color, and the Cardon Strengthening set adds salicylic acid, biotin and yeast extract for scalp care. Picked by Susy for Lakewood Ranch sun.

Restock for the new year with Susy's picks from our Sarasota hair salon: Brickell Styling Clay for matte hold, the Viking Revolution beard kit, Cardon sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner, and the MANSCAPED Lawn Mower Ultra trimmer for upkeep between visits. Siesta Key, this one's for you.
